entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • ReadyToRun: StaticVirtualMethods and InternalMethodImpl Loader tests fail since #135802 #136494
  • [browser][MT] `getNewWorker` never finds a loaded worker after the Emscripten 5.0.6 upgrade (`worker.loaded` no longer set); first `Task.Delay`/timer deadlocks JS→.NET dispatch on 11.0 rc.3 #136492
  • GCRestartEEEnd is fired after ResumeAllThreads wakes managed threads, inflating reported EE pause durations by tens of milliseconds under CPU load #136490

  • JIT: optimized `[ThreadStatic]` access can run a static constructor the JIT doesn't know about (stale reads after it) #136480
    12.0.0
  • InvalidOperationException "Handle is not initialized." on a .NET TP Worker, thrown from ThreadPoolTypedWorkItemQueue.Execute (IOCP completion path), .NET 10 on Wine #136479
  • [iOS] CoreCLR: a GC during the first call through an interpreted instantiating stub leaves the callee a stale `this` #136472
    12.0.0

    12.0.0
  • [API Proposal]: Generator-facing JSExport registration and function-pointer binding #136464
    12.0.0
